notes: FG Consumption screen ab khali khulti hai — plan (number + date ke saath) aur department khud select karein. Tank popup mein Save button khatam: band karne par entries save ho jati hain, pehle se saved quantity bhi wahi se edit ho sakti hai, aur rows ko drag karke apni marzi ki tartib bana sakte hain — tartib save rehti hai. Kisi doosre tank se aya hua material basket/delete par stock ki bajaye apne purane tank mein wapas jata hai. OUT tank par Revert button hai (ghalat OUT wapas READY ho jata hai); return weight save karne se pehle warning ati hai, aur ek dafa save ho jaye to wo hissa lock ho jata hai. Upar wale menu mein Save ki jagah Save as Draft + Post hai, drafts list se dubara khul sakte hain. List View mein plan ke tamam ready tank ek saath nazar ate hain, wahi se Out, return aur Revert ho sakta hai. Returned Tanks ab poori screen hai — tank par tap karne se us ka material nazar ata hai aur Shift bhi wahi se hota hai.
releaseNotes: FG Consumption weak-points pack: R1 provenance routing (transferred content returns to its source tank on basket/delete, recreated at the recorded owner when gone; only self-added material credits stock); R2 OUT-tank Revert, locked forever once a return is saved; R3 blank screen open, plan dropdown shows number + date; R4 prep rows drag-reorder persisted per user + phase in app_config; R5 no popup Save button (close saves), saved entries editable while in preparation; R6 Save as Draft + Drafts list + Post (finalize) in the header menu; R7 Returned Tanks full screen, tap for read-only composition, Shift only; R9 current-plan List View (prepared tanks only, Out/return/Revert inline), OUT Revert + return controls below the popup, return-weight warning confirmation on every save path; R10 drafts behave exactly like active plans until Posted.
